subject.title: Will Browser automation get my account in trouble with OpenAI?

question: Should Oracle publish current account-risk guidance for ChatGPT browser automation, or treat the older same-topic support answer as still sufficient?
rationale: Source inspection can show how browser mode behaves, but it cannot safely decide OpenAI account enforcement or the reassurance level maintainers want to publish.

options.title: Post cautious current guidance
options.body: Answer the user without legal guarantees, call browser mode operationally sensitive/experimental, and point risk-averse users to API mode or manual paste; optionally follow with a small FAQ note.

options.title: Close as covered by prior discussion
options.body: Close with a link to https://github.com/steipete/oracle/issues/96 if maintainers consider that owner answer still current enough.

options.title: Hold for policy clarity
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers have a current policy source or decide not to publish a project stance.

recommendation.title: Post cautious current guidance
recommendation.body: Answer the user without legal guarantees, call browser mode operationally sensitive/experimental, and point risk-averse users to API mode or manual paste; optionally follow with a small FAQ note.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete answered the prior same-topic issue and has the strongest current history signal on browser-mode docs and policy-sensitive automation notes.
